page.overview:
Who is An Zengaiina?

An Zengaiina is a prisoner on Level 2 of Impel Down.

Zengaiina is a man with fair skin, short light brown hair, tiny black eye irises, hollow sunken black eye baggages, and a stitch patterned scar on the upper right side of his forehead. He wears the standard white prisoner outfit with black horizontal stripes, trousers, and white shoes.

In episode 1152, Zengaiina is depicted with white hair, and also looks more like how he is depicted in the manga than his first appearance in the anime.

Though Zengaiina hated Impel Down, he was too afraid of the Sphinx to leave his cell when Monkey D. Luffy and Buggy tried to break him and his fellow prisoners out.
